name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City, UT) Sweet Cinnamon Sugar & Butter Crepe
brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Thin, delicate French-style batter cooked soft on a round griddle. Folded with sweet cream butter and light cinnamon sugar. Completely seed-free, nut-free, and practically zero residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cinnamon Sugar and Butter Crepe warm; enjoy as a gentle morning carb before a day on the lake.
